main.description: Takes the account out of the triagers of the repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as `knotless triager remove` does. Its owner can, logged in to this appview's web pages: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account, which the pages' session cookie names. For an organization's repository, so can an admin who joined it, logged in to the pages or with a service token from their own PDS for this method: the appview's gateway, which the organization delegated its writes to, writes as the organization.

errors.description: The account is no triager of it, or there is no such account.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

errors.description: The account logged in is not the repository's owner.
errors.name: Forbidden

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

who.description: The account, by handle or DID.

description: Stops counting an account's labels on a repository.
